items.title: MPs call for Heathrow expansion plans to be paused over climate and economic concerns
items.summary: # MPs call for Heathrow expansion plans to be paused over climate and economic concerns The Government has failed to make the case for a third runway at Heathrow Airport, according to a new report from the Transport Committee, which has raised concerns over the proposed expansion’s compatibility with the UK’s legally binding climate targets and its projected economic benefits.

items.title: Primark cuts Scope 3 emissions by 21% as supplier data improves accuracy of carbon reporting
items.summary: # Primark cuts Scope 3 emissions by 21% as supplier data improves accuracy of carbon reporting Primark has reduced its Scope 3 greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions by 21% year on year in 2025/26, with improved access to factory-level data helping the retailer produce a more accurate picture of emissions across its supply chain.

items.title: COP31 was the darkest hour for climate diplomacy. It must also be a turning point.
items.summary: # COP31 was the darkest hour for climate diplomacy. It must also be a turning point. COP31 in Antalya will be remembered as one of the darkest hours in the history of climate diplomacy.

items.title: European Parliament endorses two-year delay on methane reporting
items.summary: # European Parliament endorses two-year delay on methane reporting The European Parliament has endorsed plans for Member States to delay methane monitoring and reporting requirements for fossil fuel importers by two years.

items.title: ‘Sinking’ African megacities will expose seven million people to flooding by 2050
items.summary: Sinking land and rising seas could expose more than seven million people living in Africa’s coastal “megacities” to flooding by the middle of the century, according to new research.

items.title: 楊沛為、M.V.拉瑪納／核能不是台灣AI和半導體產業用電需求成長的解方
items.summary: AI技術的發展以及算力和先進晶片需求的成長，正在推升許多國家當前與未來的用電需求。其中，台灣作為 ，加上增設資料中心的規劃，如何滿足這波電力需求的成長，自然已成能源政策的首要課題之一。面對這些新增的用電需求，部分人士和政商代表主張台灣應恢復核能發電。
